summary:
Live and operational facts observed on 2026-10-22 and posted to #4707 and #4516; refresh from the receiver before action, because they will change.

State: Host 0.8.0 serves the schema-14 store `store14-v1` (#4707 comment 6342802444; #4516 comment 6342801775). The step 3d cutover committed at 14:05Z after a 21.4 s outage and was accepted by independent review with all 36 recorded gates true. The previous schema-12 store (uv12) was kept pristine for rollback; the rollback window runs to 2026-10-23 14:10Z, and rolling back discards anything ingested on uv14. Credential `home-passive-programme-v1` for producer `codex-passive-home-01`, stream `native-usage`, workspace `utel-home-20261003` was enrolled and committed at about 15:05Z (outage 20.1 s; #4516 comment 6344035100). The enrollment left Host on 0.8.0 with lifetime receipts 4 and pending 0 until the first send.

Mechanics established from source and review (#4516 comments 6343204826, 6343331328; Host Program.fs and HostRuntime.fs): credentials load only at `serve` start, so enrolling needs a restart of serve. `enroll-producer` requires the credential to be already declared in the config with matching reference, secret file, workspace, producer, stream and revoked flag, runs under the service lock (so while serve is stopped), and writes the principal through an INSERT OR IGNORE, so exit 0 alone can hide an already-enrolled no-op; check the status and row delta. `/private/health` accepts any non-revoked config credential (Runtime.authenticate on the Bearer check), so a new credential can be health-checked before any send; dashboard login is separate (browser principals, rate limited per process) and is not authenticated by these credentials. `status` run through `podman exec` while serve holds the lock reports `process: "unknown"`, which is not a failure. Planned expectation, not yet an observed 0.8.0 result at capture: the first passive POST is expected to return 202 `durably-received` (#4516 comment 6343768096), with application later; accepting a receipt needs the `applied` transport receipt, not the 202.

The cutover committed on admission 5. Two earlier executes rolled back cleanly for different causes: admission 3 refused at P2 because a gate required more than needed (a 0-byte -wal and a -shm left after the stop; #4516 comment 6342485532), and admission 4 failed on two of the operator's own probe defects, a `process == "running"` requirement that `status` through `podman exec` cannot meet and a dashboard login rate-limit (429) caused by re-running the whole health set every few seconds, while 0.8.0 itself was healthy (#4516 comment 6342582454). Admission 5 committed (#4516 comments 6342600785, 6342801775).

Limits: dated operational observations, not a standing contract. The published Host contract and release boundary stay in contract/telemetry-host; this record grants no enrollment, send, retention-cleanup or rollback authority.
title: Home UTEL receiver serves Host 0.8.0 on schema-14 store14-v1; live state dated 2026-10-22
